newsitem.title: USA: Disney eyes Orlando cartoon expansion - paper.
newsitem.headline: Disney eyes Orlando cartoon expansion - paper.

text.p: Walt Disney Co will announce on Friday a major expansion of its animation operations at Disney-MGM Studios, The Orlando Sentinel newspaper said.
The expansion will be anchored by a new 200,000-square-foot building and help house 150 additional animators, the newspaper said.
Disney already employs 360 artists and support staff, up from 70, when the Disney-MGM studio and theme park opened in 1989. Some current animators now work in temporary buildings.
Disney animators in Orlando are working on "Mulan," a movie based on Chinese folklore set for theatrical release in 1998.
